questions.question: En muchas zonas rurales, los estudiantes no tienen acceso a Internet de alta velocidad. Esta «brecha digital» limita sus oportunidades educativas. ¿Qué significa «brecha digital»?
questions.correctAnswer: La desigualdad en el acceso a la tecnología y a Internet
distractors: Un tipo de computadora muy rápida
Un programa para aprender idiomas en línea
La velocidad máxima de una conexión inalámbrica
questions.explanation: «Brecha» means a gap or divide, so «brecha digital» is the digital divide: the unequal access to technology and the Internet between different groups or regions. It is a central idea in the AP theme La ciencia y la tecnología, under the context El acceso a la tecnología.
questions.memoryHook: Picture a canyon (una brecha) between two towns - one side has fast Wi-Fi and the other has none. That gap is la brecha digital.

questions.question: Gracias a la telemedicina, los pacientes de pueblos pequeños pueden hablar con un médico sin viajar a la ciudad. ¿Qué es la telemedicina?
questions.correctAnswer: La atención médica a distancia por medio de la tecnología
distractors: Un medicamento nuevo para enfermedades graves
El estudio de las plantas medicinales
questions.explanation: La telemedicina (tele- = distance, as in teléfono) is medical care provided remotely through video calls, apps, and messages. It belongs to the context El cuidado de la salud y la medicina within the AP theme La ciencia y la tecnología.
questions.memoryHook: Tele- means 'far away' - la telemedicina is a doctor's visit from far away, through a screen.

questions.question: El aumento de la temperatura del planeta, causado por los gases de efecto invernadero, se conoce como ______.
questions.explanation: El calentamiento global is global warming: the rise in the planet's temperature caused by greenhouse gases (los gases de efecto invernadero). It is a core topic of Los temas del medio ambiente in the AP theme Los desafíos mundiales.
questions.memoryHook: Calentamiento = warming up - el calentamiento global is the planet running a fever.

questions.question: En la Amazonía, la destrucción de grandes áreas de bosque para la agricultura amenaza a miles de especies. ¿Cómo se llama este problema ambiental?
questions.explanation: La deforestación is the destruction or clearing of forests; note the trap la reforestación, which means the opposite - planting trees again (re-). The Amazon rainforest is a classic AP example in Los temas del medio ambiente.
questions.memoryHook: De- takes the forest away; re- (reforestación) puts it back.

questions.question: What is the capital of Spain?
questions.explanation: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain, located in the center of the country.
questions.memoryHook: Madrid is the heart of Spain!

questions.question: Lee la frase: «Aunque las redes sociales facilitan la comunicación, también pueden causar adicción en los adolescentes». Según la frase, ¿cuál es un efecto negativo de las redes sociales?
questions.correctAnswer: Pueden crear dependencia en los jóvenes
distractors: Conectan a personas de diferentes países
questions.explanation: The sentence concedes a benefit (facilitan la comunicación), but the negative effect comes after «también»: pueden causar adicción. Adicción and dependencia are synonyms here. This is the context Los efectos de la tecnología en el individuo y en la sociedad.
questions.memoryHook: «Aunque» signals a contrast coming - the downside hides after it. Here the downside is la adicción.

questions.question: Lee el texto: «En muchos países, la población está envejeciendo: hay más personas mayores y menos nacimientos. Como resultado, los gobiernos deben pensar en cómo pagar las pensiones y cuidar la salud de los ancianos». Según el texto, ¿cuál es una consecuencia del envejecimiento de la población?
questions.correctAnswer: Los gobiernos deben planear el pago de pensiones y el cuidado de los mayores
distractors: Aumenta rápidamente el número de nacimientos
Hay más niños en las escuelas primarias
Disminuye la necesidad de servicios de salud
questions.explanation: The text gives the consequence directly: governments must plan for las pensiones and la salud de los ancianos. The other options contradict the text - births are falling (menos nacimientos) and health needs grow, not shrink. This is La población y la demografía in Los desafíos mundiales.
questions.memoryHook: More abuelos, fewer bebés - la población está envejeciendo.

questions.question: Cuando una familia no tiene suficientes recursos para cubrir sus necesidades básicas, como la comida y la vivienda, vive en ______.
questions.explanation: La pobreza (poverty) is the lack of resources to cover basic needs - food (la comida), housing (la vivienda), health. It is the opposite of la riqueza (wealth) and la abundancia (abundance), and a central topic in Los temas económicos.
questions.memoryHook: Pobreza is when the basics - comida, vivienda - are out of reach.

questions.question: Un programa de computadora que aprende de la información y puede reconocer voces e imágenes es un ejemplo de ______.
questions.explanation: La inteligencia artificial (IA) refers to computer systems that learn from data and perform tasks such as recognizing speech and images. It is one of Las innovaciones tecnológicas in the AP theme La ciencia y la tecnología.
questions.memoryHook: If the program aprende (learns) by itself, think IA - inteligencia artificial.

questions.question: Completa la oración: «Es importante que todos nosotros ______ el agua en casa».
questions.explanation: Impersonal expressions of importance (es importante que) trigger the subjunctive, and with the subject nosotros the form is ahorremos, from ahorrar (to save). Ahorramos is indicative, ahorrar is the infinitive, and ahorraron is preterite.
questions.memoryHook: Es importante que opens the subjunctive door - ahorrar steps through as ahorremos.

questions.question: La cantidad de gases contaminantes que produce una persona o una actividad se llama ______.
questions.explanation: La huella de carbono (carbon footprint) measures the greenhouse gases produced by a person, a product, or an activity. Una huella is a footprint or trace - the mark our activities leave on the atmosphere. It belongs to Los temas del medio ambiente.
questions.memoryHook: Huella = footprint. Your huella de carbono is the mark your day leaves on the sky.

questions.question: Completa la oración: «Si los gobiernos invirtieran más en infraestructura digital, más estudiantes ______ acceso a clases en línea».
questions.explanation: This is a hypothetical si-clause: si + imperfect subjunctive (invirtieran) pairs with the conditional in the result clause, so the correct form is tendrían (they would have). Tienen is present, tuvieron is preterite, and tengan is present subjunctive - none of them completes the hypothetical pattern si + imperfecto de subjuntivo → condicional.
questions.memoryHook: Si + -ra form (invirtieran) always calls for the -ría form (tendrían) - they travel as a pair.

questions.question: Which Spanish-speaking country is home to Machu Picchu?
questions.explanation: Machu Picchu is an Incan citadel in Peru, built in the 15th century.

questions.question: Lee el texto: «En un barrio de la ciudad, un grupo de voluntarios abrió un comedor comunitario donde las personas sin hogar pueden comer gratis todos los días. También ofrecen clases para ayudar a los visitantes a buscar empleo». ¿Cuál es el propósito principal del comedor comunitario?
questions.correctAnswer: Ayudar a las personas necesitadas con comida y apoyo para encontrar trabajo
distractors: Vender comida barata a los vecinos del barrio
Crear un restaurante para los turistas
questions.explanation: The text says the volunteers feed las personas sin hogar (homeless people) for free and help them buscar empleo (look for work) - food plus job support. Community programs like this are part of El bienestar social in Los desafíos mundiales.
questions.memoryHook: Un comedor comunitario feeds the body and the future - comida hoy, empleo mañana.

questions.question: Los paneles solares convierten la luz del sol en electricidad. ¿Cómo se clasifica esta fuente de energía?
distractors: Es un fenómeno natural sin uso práctico
questions.explanation: Solar energy is una energía renovable because the sun's light is naturally replenished and does not run out, unlike los combustibles fósiles (coal, oil, gas). Solar technology is part of Las innovaciones tecnológicas in La ciencia y la tecnología.
questions.memoryHook: If nature refills it for free - sol, viento, agua - it is renovable.

questions.question: Completa la oración: «Con una computadora más rápida, yo ______ todos mis proyectos en menos tiempo, pero mi computadora actual es muy lenta».
questions.explanation: The phrase «con una computadora más rápida» sets up a hypothetical situation, so Spanish uses the conditional: terminaría (I would finish). The conditional of regular verbs is formed with the infinitive + -ía: terminar + ía = terminaría.
questions.memoryHook: The -ría ending is the 'would' ending - terminaría = I would finish.

questions.question: Which country is the largest Spanish-speaking country by area?
questions.explanation: Argentina is the largest by land area at about 2.78 million square kilometers. Mexico is next at about 1.96 million, so area - not population - is what makes Argentina the answer.

questions.question: Un movimiento social lucha para que todas las personas tengan los mismos derechos y oportunidades, sin importar su origen. ¿Qué valor defiende el movimiento?
questions.explanation: Los mismos derechos y oportunidades para todos is la igualdad (equality). Social movements that defend equality are an expression of La conciencia social in the AP theme Los desafíos mundiales.
questions.memoryHook: Mismos derechos, mismas oportunidades - that is la igualdad.

questions.question: Lee el texto: «Los científicos usan satélites para observar los huracanes desde el espacio. Con estas imágenes, pueden predecir la trayectoria de la tormenta y avisar a las comunidades costeras con varios días de anticipación». ¿Cuál es el propósito principal de los satélites según el texto?
questions.correctAnswer: Ayudar a predecir las tormentas y proteger a las comunidades
distractors: Fotografiar las costas para los turistas
Reemplazar a los científicos en la Tierra
Controlar el clima de la región
questions.explanation: The text states that the satellites let scientists predecir la trayectoria (predict the path) and avisar a las comunidades (warn the communities) - prediction and protection, not control of the weather. This connects technology with Los fenómenos naturales.
questions.memoryHook: Los satélites are the sky's weather reporters - they watch la tormenta so people can prepare.

questions.question: Cuando miles de personas se trasladan del campo a la ciudad para vivir y trabajar, participan en un proceso de ______.
questions.explanation: La migración is the movement of people from one place to another in order to live and work. La modernización means adopting new technology and ways of life, while la migración names the people's movement itself - a key idea in La población y la demografía.
questions.memoryHook: People on the move = migración. New technology and updates = modernización.

questions.question: Which Spanish artist painted Guernica?
questions.explanation: Pablo Picasso painted Guernica in 1937 in response to the bombing of the Basque town during the Spanish Civil War.

questions.question: Antes de instalar una aplicación, es importante leer cómo la empresa usa tus datos personales. ¿Qué concepto se relaciona con la protección de tu información personal?
questions.explanation: La privacidad (privacy) is the concept behind protecting your datos personales - who can see and use your information. Debates about privacy and data are part of La ciencia y la ética in the AP theme La ciencia y la tecnología.
questions.memoryHook: Tus datos personales are your digital diary - la privacidad is the lock on it.

questions.question: Guardar documentos en «la nube» permite acceder a ellos desde cualquier dispositivo con Internet. ¿Qué significa «la nube» en este contexto?
questions.correctAnswer: Un sistema de almacenamiento de datos en Internet
distractors: Una parte física de la computadora
Un tipo de pantalla para tabletas
questions.explanation: In technology, la nube (the cloud) is not weather: it is remote storage on Internet servers, so files can be opened from any connected device. Almacenamiento means storage.
questions.memoryHook: La nube here is not in the sky - your files float on servers, not on water vapor.

questions.question: Completa la oración: «Los ciudadanos esperan que el gobierno ______ nuevas leyes para proteger los ríos y los bosques».
questions.explanation: Esperar que (to hope that) expresses hope about another subject's action, so it requires the present subjunctive: apruebe, from aprobar (to pass or approve a law). Aprueba is indicative, aprobar is the infinitive, and aprobó is preterite.
questions.memoryHook: Esperan que = fingers crossed - hope triggers the subjunctive: apruebe.

questions.question: Cuando la fábrica cerró, cientos de personas perdieron su trabajo y el nivel de ______ en la región aumentó.
questions.explanation: El desempleo is unemployment - the lack of jobs. Note the prefix des-, which reverses empleo (employment): when the factory closed, empleo fell and desempleo rose. Unemployment is a central topic in Los temas económicos.
questions.memoryHook: Des- undoes it: empleo is a job, desempleo is the job that disappeared.

questions.question: Which festival is famous in Pamplona, Spain?
questions.explanation: The Running of the Bulls (San Fermín) takes place in Pamplona each July.

questions.question: Lee el texto: «El cambio climático afecta directamente a los agricultores: las sequías más largas reducen las cosechas de maíz y frijoles. Sin ingresos suficientes, muchas familias del campo deben decidir entre quedarse o emigrar». Según el texto, ¿por qué emigran algunas familias del campo?
questions.correctAnswer: Porque las sequías reducen sus cosechas y sus ingresos
distractors: Porque prefieren el clima de las ciudades
Porque el gobierno les ofrece casas nuevas
Porque ya no necesitan trabajar la tierra
questions.explanation: The text gives a cause chain: longer droughts (las sequías) → smaller harvests (las cosechas) → insufficient income (sin ingresos suficientes) → families emigrate. Climate pressure on food and income is where Los temas del medio ambiente meet Los temas económicos.
questions.memoryHook: Sin lluvia no hay cosecha; sin cosecha no hay ingresos - so families se van.

questions.question: Lee el texto: «Un estudio reciente muestra que muchos adolescentes revisan su teléfono más de cien veces al día. Los expertos recomiendan apagar las notificaciones por la noche para dormir mejor, porque la luz de la pantalla puede afectar el sueño». Según el texto, ¿qué recomiendan los expertos?
questions.correctAnswer: Apagar las notificaciones durante la noche
distractors: Revisar el teléfono con más frecuencia
Usar la pantalla justo antes de dormir
questions.explanation: The recommendation is stated directly: recomiendan apagar las notificaciones por la noche para dormir mejor (to sleep better). The text describes an effect of technology on health - Los efectos de la tecnología en el individuo y en la sociedad.
questions.memoryHook: Apagar las notificaciones = silence the buzz, save el sueño.

questions.question: Completa la oración: «Los médicos recomiendan que la gente ______ menos tiempo frente a las pantallas».
questions.explanation: After recomiendan que with a change of subject (los médicos → la gente), Spanish requires the present subjunctive: pase. La gente is grammatically singular, so the form is pase, not pasan. Pase is the present subjunctive of pasar.
questions.memoryHook: Recomiendan que flips the switch to subjunctive - pasar becomes pase.

questions.question: Which country speaks Spanish and is in Europe?
questions.explanation: Spain is the only Spanish-speaking country in Europe and the origin of the Spanish language.

questions.question: When do you use 'ser' rather than 'estar'?
questions.correctAnswer: For identity, origin, and inherent traits
questions.explanation: Ser is used for identity, origin, profession, physical traits, and time. Estar is used for location, condition, mood, and progressive actions.
questions.memoryHook: Ser is for what something IS, estar for how it is!

questions.question: What is the preterite yo form of 'hablar'?
questions.explanation: Hablé is the preterite yo form of hablar: regular -ar verbs take -é in the yo preterite. Hablo is present, hablaba is imperfect, and hablaré is future. Hable without the accent is the present subjunctive, not the preterite.
questions.memoryHook: Hablé means I spoke - past done, accent on the é!

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the imperfect tense?
questions.correctAnswer: Cuando era niño, jugaba en el parque
questions.explanation: The imperfect (jugaba, era) describes ongoing or habitual past actions. The preterite (jugué) is for completed actions.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'Espero que tú ___ a la fiesta.'
questions.explanation: Vengas is the present subjunctive of venir. After expressions of hope or desire (espero que), the subjunctive is required.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'por' and 'para'?
questions.correctAnswer: Por means through/by/for (exchange); para means for (purpose/destination)
distractors: Por is formal, para is informal
Para is past, por is present
questions.explanation: Por expresses cause, exchange, movement through, and duration. Para expresses purpose, destination, recipient, and deadline.
questions.memoryHook: Por is the journey, para is the goal!

questions.question: What is the present subjunctive yo form of 'tener'?
questions.explanation: Tenga is the present subjunctive yo form of tener. It follows the go-to rule: take the yo present (tengo), drop -o, add opposite endings.

questions.question: Which is the correct direct object pronoun for 'el libro'?
questions.explanation: Lo is the masculine singular direct object pronoun, replacing el libro.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'tener que' + infinitive mean?
questions.explanation: Tener que + infinitive expresses obligation: tener que estudiar means 'to have to study'.

questions.question: Which is the correct imperfect form of 'ir' for 'ellos'?
questions.explanation: Iban is the imperfect ellos form of ir. Fueron is preterite, van is present, irán is future.
questions.memoryHook: Iban means they used to go!

questions.question: In the sentence 'Me gusta el libro', what is the subject?
questions.explanation: In gustar constructions, the thing liked (el libro) is the subject, and me is the indirect object. Literally: 'The book is pleasing to me.'

questions.question: What is the preterite form of 'ir' for 'yo'?
questions.explanation: Fui is the preterite yo form of ir (and ser - they share forms in preterite). Iba is imperfect, voy is present.
questions.memoryHook: Fui went and was - same form!

questions.question: Which word means 'although' and often triggers the subjunctive?
questions.explanation: Aunque means 'although' or 'even though' and can trigger the subjunctive when the information is uncertain or unknown.

questions.question: What is the correct translation of 'I used to play soccer'?
questions.explanation: Jugaba is the imperfect, used for habitual past actions like 'used to play'.

questions.question: Which pronoun is used as the indirect object for 'a María'?
questions.explanation: Le is the indirect object pronoun: it marks the recipient, the person something is given or done to (a María). Lo and la mark direct objects instead - le answers 'to whom?', while lo and la answer 'what?'.

questions.question: What is the future tense yo form of 'hablar'?
questions.explanation: Hablaré is the future yo form of hablar. The future is formed by adding endings to the full infinitive.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect correctly?
questions.explanation: He comido is the present perfect (haber + past participle), used for actions completed recently or with present relevance.
questions.memoryHook: He comido means I have eaten!

questions.question: What does 'acabar de' + infinitive express?
distractors: To be about to do something
questions.explanation: Acabar de + infinitive means 'to have just done something': Acabo de comer means 'I just ate'.
questions.memoryHook: Acabar de means just did it!

questions.question: Which is the correct command (tu, affirmative) for 'hablar'?
questions.explanation: Habla is the affirmative tu command of hablar, formed from the third-person present form.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'escribir'?
questions.explanation: Escrito is the irregular past participle of escribir. Escribiendo is the gerund.

questions.question: Which phrase means 'to be cold' (a person feels cold)?
questions.explanation: Tener frío is used for a person feeling cold. Hacer frío describes cold weather.

questions.question: What is the subjunctive trigger in 'Ojalá que llueva'?
questions.explanation: Ojalá (hopefully / I hope that) always triggers the subjunctive because it expresses a wish, not a fact. Que only introduces the clause - ojalá is the word that forces the subjunctive form llueva.

questions.question: Which country is famous for tango?
questions.explanation: Tango originated in the Río de la Plata region, especially Buenos Aires, Argentina, in the late 19th century.

questions.question: What does 'la sobremesa' refer to in Spanish culture?
questions.correctAnswer: Time spent chatting at the table after a meal
questions.explanation: La sobremesa is the cherished Spanish tradition of lingering at the table after eating to talk with family and friends.

questions.question: Which is the correct use of 'saber' vs 'conocer'?
questions.correctAnswer: Sé hablar español / Conozco a María
distractors: Conozco hablar español / Sé a María
Sé a María / Conozco hablar español
questions.explanation: Saber is used for facts and skills (sé hablar español). Conocer is used for knowing people and places (conozco a María).

questions.question: What is the conditional yo form of 'comer'?
questions.explanation: Comería is the conditional yo form of comer, formed by adding endings to the infinitive.

questions.question: Which author wrote Don Quixote?
questions.explanation: Miguel de Cervantes wrote Don Quixote (1605, 1615), considered the first modern novel.

questions.question: What is the gerund (present participle) of 'leer'?
questions.explanation: Leyendo is the gerund of leer (with y spelling change). Leído is the past participle.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'hace' for time?
questions.correctAnswer: Hace dos años que estudio español
distractors: Estudio español hace dos años que
questions.explanation: Hace + time + que + present tense expresses how long an action has been ongoing.
questions.memoryHook: Hace dos años que - for two years!

questions.question: What does 'Día de los Muertos' celebrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Deceased loved ones, especially in Mexico
questions.explanation: Día de los Muertos (Day of the Dead, Nov 1-2) honors deceased loved ones with altars, marigolds, and offerings, especially in Mexico.
questions.memoryHook: Day of the Dead honors loved ones!

questions.question: Which is the correct negative command (tu) for 'hablar'?
questions.explanation: No hables is the negative tu command, which uses the present subjunctive form.
questions.memoryHook: No hables - negative commands use subjunctive!

questions.question: What is the preterite form of 'hacer' for 'él'?
questions.explanation: Hizo is the preterite él form of hacer (irregular, with c changing to z before o). Hacía is imperfect, hace is present.

questions.question: Which word is a false cognate (false friend)?
questions.explanation: Embarazada means 'pregnant', not 'embarrassed'. The Spanish word for embarrassed is avergonzado/a.

questions.question: What does 'ir + a + infinitive' express?
questions.correctAnswer: The near future (going to do something)
questions.explanation: Ir + a + infinitive is the informal future: Voy a estudiar means 'I am going to study'.
questions.memoryHook: Voy a means going to do it!

questions.question: Which is the correct reflexive pronoun for 'yo'?
questions.explanation: Me is the reflexive pronoun for yo: me levanto means 'I get up'.
questions.memoryHook: Me levanto - I get myself up!

questions.question: What is the imperfect subjunctive form of 'hablar' for 'yo'?
questions.explanation: Hablara is the imperfect subjunctive yo form of hablar, formed from the third-person plural preterite (hablaron) minus -on plus endings.

questions.question: Which Spanish-speaking country is the birthplace of salsa music?
questions.explanation: Salsa music developed from Cuban son and other Caribbean rhythms, with strong roots in Cuba and Puerto Rico.
questions.memoryHook: Cuba moves to the salsa beat!

questions.question: What does 'estar de acuerdo' mean?
questions.explanation: Estar de acuerdo means 'to agree' (literally 'to be in agreement').

questions.question: Which is the correct comparative: 'Maria is taller than Juan'?
questions.correctAnswer: María es más alta que Juan
distractors: María es más alta de Juan
María es tan alta que Juan
questions.explanation: Más... que is the comparative structure for 'more... than': the adjective sits between más and que. Tan... como is a different pair, used for 'as... as'.

questions.question: What is the superlative of 'bueno'?
questions.explanation: El mejor is the irregular superlative of bueno (the best). Buenísimo is the absolute superlative (very good).

questions.question: Which tense is used in 'Si tuviera dinero, viajaría'?
questions.explanation: Si tuviera (imperfect subjunctive) + viajaría (conditional) forms a hypothetical if-clause about an unreal present situation.

questions.question: In 'El libro que leí era interesante', what is 'que'?
questions.correctAnswer: A relative pronoun introducing an adjective clause
questions.explanation: Que here is a relative pronoun: it links the clause que leí back to its antecedent, el libro, the thing that was read. Unlike English, Spanish cannot drop this que - 'the book I read' still needs que in Spanish.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive after a conjunction of purpose?
questions.correctAnswer: Estudio para que mis padres estén orgullosos
distractors: Estudio para que mis padres están orgullosos
Estudio para mis padres están orgullosos
Estudio que mis padres estén orgullosos
questions.explanation: Para que (so that) is a purpose conjunction that always triggers the subjunctive (estén) when the subject changes: I study, but my parents are the ones who are proud. With the same subject, Spanish uses para + infinitive instead.

questions.question: What is the literary movement of Gabriel García Márquez's One Hundred Years of Solitude?
questions.explanation: One Hundred Years of Solitude (1967) is the defining work of magical realism, blending fantastical elements with realistic narrative.

questions.question: Which is correct: 'Busco un libro que ___ interesante'?
questions.explanation: Sea (present subjunctive) is used because the antecedent (un libro) is indefinite or nonexistent - the speaker does not have a specific book in mind.

questions.question: What does the AP Spanish Language exam's interpersonal writing task require?
questions.correctAnswer: A reply to an email with a greeting, response, questions, and closing
questions.explanation: The AP interpersonal writing task gives you 15 minutes to reply to an email in a formal register. A complete reply greets the sender, answers every question asked, asks for more information or details, and closes politely - leaving out any one of these loses points.
questions.memoryHook: AP email reply needs all four parts!

questions.question: Which preterite form is irregular in the stem: 'tener' for 'yo'?
questions.explanation: Tuve is the irregular preterite yo form of tener, built on the tuv- stem. Tenía is imperfect and tendré is future - only tuve is preterite.
questions.memoryHook: Tuve is the tuv- stem irregular!

questions.question: In 'Se venden casas', what is 'se'?
questions.explanation: Se venden casas is a passive se construction, equivalent to 'houses are sold', with the verb agreeing with the subject.

questions.question: Which is the correct past subjunctive after 'si' for a contrary-to-fact present condition?
questions.correctAnswer: Si yo fuera rico, compraría una casa
distractors: Si yo soy rico, compro una casa
Si yo era rico, compraba una casa
Si yo fui rico, compré una casa
questions.explanation: Si + imperfect subjunctive (fuera) + conditional (compraría) expresses a contrary-to-fact present condition.

questions.question: What is 'el voseo'?
questions.correctAnswer: The use of 'vos' instead of 'tú' in parts of Latin America
questions.explanation: El voseo is the use of vos (with its own verb forms) instead of tú, common in Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay, and parts of Central America.
questions.memoryHook: Voseo means vos instead of tú!

questions.question: Which work is by Federico Garcia Lorca?
questions.explanation: La casa de Bernarda Alba (1936) is Lorca's famous rural tragedy. Don Quixote is by Cervantes, La vida es sueño is by Calderón de la Barca, and La Celestina is by Fernando de Rojas.

questions.question: What is the function of 'lo' in 'Lo importante es estudiar'?
questions.correctAnswer: A neuter article introducing an abstract concept
questions.explanation: Lo + adjective creates an abstract noun: lo importante means 'the important thing'. Lo here is a neuter article.
questions.memoryHook: Lo importante is abstract - neuter lo!

questions.question: Which sentence uses the present perfect subjunctive correctly?
questions.explanation: Haya + past participle (hayas estudiado) is the present perfect subjunctive, used after espero que for a completed action with present relevance.

questions.question: What is the main theme of Jorge Luis Borges' stories?
questions.correctAnswer: Labyrinths, mirrors, infinity, and the nature of reality
questions.explanation: Borges' stories famously explore labyrinths, mirrors, infinite libraries, doubles, and philosophical questions about reality and identity.

questions.question: Which is the correct use of 'por' in 'Gracias por tu ayuda'?
questions.correctAnswer: Por expresses gratitude for a cause or exchange
questions.explanation: Por in gracias por expresses the reason or cause for thanks - thanks for (because of) your help.
questions.memoryHook: Gracias por - thanks for the cause!

questions.question: What does the AP Spanish Language exam's presentational speaking task involve?
questions.correctAnswer: A 2-minute cultural comparison between the student's community and a Spanish-speaking community
questions.explanation: The AP cultural comparison asks students to speak for 2 minutes comparing a cultural topic in their own community with a Spanish-speaking community.

questions.question: Which verb form follows 'antes de que'?
questions.explanation: Antes de que (before) always triggers the subjunctive because the action has not yet occurred.

questions.question: What is 'la siesta'?
questions.correctAnswer: A traditional afternoon rest period in Spain and Latin America
questions.explanation: La siesta is the traditional afternoon rest, especially in Spain, when shops close and people rest during the hottest hours.

questions.question: Which is correct: 'El problema es que no ___ tiempo'?
questions.explanation: Tengo (indicative) is correct because 'el problema es que' states a fact, not a doubt or emotion, so no subjunctive is triggered.
questions.memoryHook: Es que states a fact - indicative!

questions.question: What is the significance of Frida Kahlo in Mexican culture?
questions.correctAnswer: Iconic painter known for self-portraits exploring identity, pain, and Mexican heritage
questions.explanation: Frida Kahlo (1907-1954) is Mexico's most famous painter, known for vivid self-portraits blending personal suffering with Mexican folk art and identity.

questions.question: Which construction expresses an unintentional action ('I dropped the glass')?
questions.explanation: Se me cayó el vaso is the accidental se construction: literally 'the glass fell itself to me', expressing an unintentional action.

questions.question: What is the pluperfect (past perfect) form of 'hablar' for 'yo'?
questions.explanation: Había hablado is the pluperfect (había + past participle), used for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: Which country celebrates 'Las Fallas' in March?
questions.explanation: Las Fallas is Valencia, Spain's famous March festival featuring giant satirical sculptures that are burned on March 19.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'conocer' and 'saber' in 'Conozco bien la ciudad'?
questions.correctAnswer: Conocer is used for familiarity with places
questions.explanation: Conocer is used for being familiar with places and people. Saber is for facts and skills. Conozco bien la ciudad means 'I know the city well'.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a double object pronoun?
questions.explanation: Me lo dio is correct: indirect object (me) comes before direct object (lo), both before the conjugated verb.
questions.memoryHook: Me lo dio - indirect before direct!

questions.question: What is 'el Camino de Santiago'?
questions.correctAnswer: A network of pilgrimage routes to Santiago de Compostela in Spain
questions.explanation: El Camino de Santiago is a network of ancient pilgrimage routes leading to the shrine of St. James in Santiago de Compostela, Galicia, Spain.

questions.question: Which is the correct future perfect form of 'estudiar' for 'yo'?
questions.explanation: Habré estudiado is the future perfect (habré + past participle), used for actions that will have been completed by a future time.
questions.memoryHook: Habré estudiado is will have studied!

questions.question: What does 'madrugador' mean?
questions.explanation: Madrugador means 'early riser' - someone who gets up early. From madrugar (to get up early).

questions.question: Which author is associated with the Latin American Boom?
distractors: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz
questions.explanation: Mario Vargas Llosa (Peru, Nobel 2010) is a central figure of the Latin American Boom of the 1960s-70s, along with García Márquez, Cortázar, and Fuentes.
questions.memoryHook: Vargas Llosa boomed with Latin America!

questions.question: What is the correct translation of 'The book was written by Cervantes'?
questions.correctAnswer: El libro fue escrito por Cervantes
distractors: El libro era escrito por Cervantes
El libro se escribió por Cervantes
questions.explanation: Fue escrito is the true passive (ser + past participle), used for actions with a stated agent (por Cervantes).

questions.question: Which AP Spanish Language skill is tested by the audio source in the presentational writing task?
questions.correctAnswer: Synthesizing information from multiple sources (audio, print, chart) into a persuasive essay
questions.explanation: The AP presentational writing task requires synthesizing three sources (article, chart, audio) into a persuasive essay with a clear thesis and evidence.
questions.memoryHook: AP persuasive essay synthesizes three sources!
